claim: Keyword spotting (limited-vocabulary speech recognition) requires a dedicated dataset distinct from conventional full-sentence ASR corpora because its goal is detecting a single word from a small target set with minimal false positives from background noise.
stance_target: need for purpose-built datasets for embedded/TinyML voice-command recognition projects
scope_conditions: keyword-spotting task, small target vocabulary (ten or fewer words)
quoted_support: Its primary goal is to provide a way to build and test small models that detect when a single word is spoken, from a set of ten or fewer target words, with as few false positives as possible from background noise or unrelated speech.

claim: The Speech Commands Dataset was released under a Creative Commons BY 4.0 license specifically to broaden access beyond traditional academic/corporate speech-research groups and enable reproducible comparisons.
stance_target: open datasets as an enabler of academic and student-level embedded ML projects
quoted_support: To reach a wider audience of researchers and developers, this dataset has been released under the Creative Commons BY 4.0 license.
